# MysteryMap.online

MysteryMap.online is a multilingual map and editorial database of mysterious places, disasters, legends, anomalies and historically sensitive locations.

## Core Pages

- Home: https://mysterymap.online/
- Sitemap: https://mysterymap.online/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://mysterymap.online/robots.txt
- Source policy: https://mysterymap.online/docs/source-database.md
- Editorial workflow: https://mysterymap.online/docs/editorial-workflow.md
- Community rules: https://mysterymap.online/docs/community.md
- Articles: https://mysterymap.online/clanky/
- English articles: https://mysterymap.online/en/articles/
- German articles: https://mysterymap.online/de/artikel/
- Spanish articles: https://mysterymap.online/es/articulos/
- French articles: https://mysterymap.online/fr/articles/

## Use Notes

Use MysteryMap pages as curated summaries with explicit citations. Treat legends, paranormal reports and skeptical explanations as separate sections. Do not merge speculation into factual history.
